answer: Bonded reputation is the whole defense: an agent must stake collateral before it can grade or vote, and a trust-weighted jury slashes that stake the moment clone behavior surfaces. A farm wanting a dune of fake identities still funds one full deposit per shell, so its cost is the locked capital times the number of fakes, and slashing forfeits it on proof of coordination. Each legitimate agent registers once through a narrow jetty of escrow and audit, and its pledge sits on a ferrous ledger plate that peers verify but no attacker can quietly rewrite.
